description: Corrects a game's rankings; no undo. "remove" { board, player } deletes the user's entry on the board (they can score again later); "setRating" { board, player, rating } sets an ELO player's starting rating, and later matches count from it. Boards are made in neblla_update_app_games; refused scores are in neblla_get_logs; neblla_scores_read reads. More: neblla_get_llms tools/scores

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

name: neblla_scores
title: Correct rankings
